mainEntity.name: How much does an office renovation cost in Petaling Jaya?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost typically ranges from RM 40 to RM 150+ per square foot. This depends on whether you need basic cosmetic updates or a full corporate fit-out with glass partitions, custom carpentry, and M&E works.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle office reinstatement in PJ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we specialize in office reinstatement. We help tenants dismantle partitions, remove flooring, and repaint the unit to its original bare condition to meet strict landlord handover requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can your team work on weekends or at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. High-rise office buildings in PJ usually prohibit noisy works during business hours. We schedule drilling and hacking for nights and weekends to comply with your building management's rules.

mainEntity.name: Do you assist with MBPJ permits and building management approvals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We have extensive experience navigating local council (MBPJ) regulations and building management protocols, ensuring all your renovation applications and refundable deposits are processed smoothly.
